title: Enforcing Ellipsoidal Constraints in Neural Networks with a Polynomial Safety Layer
abstract: arXiv:2611.19366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Often the output of a learned mapping must satisfy prescribed constraints. In the control of autonomous systems, for example, the chosen action must keep the system within a collision-free region. We consider the case in which a proposed output is corrected by projection onto a safety ellipsoid. Computing this projection amounts to solving a quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP). We construct a neural-network safety layer by unrolling a feasibility-preserving polynomial penalty iteration. The unrolled structure allows the loss gradient to propagate from the feasible output through the safety layer to the network parameters during training. We show how to choose the layer parameters so that every iterate is feasible and give a computable bound on its distance to the exact projection at any prescribed depth. translated_title: 基于多项式安全层的神经网络椭球约束强制执行方法
translated_abstract: 学习到的映射的输出通常需要满足预设的约束条件。例如，在自主系统的控制中，所选择的动作必须使系统保持在无碰撞区域内。我们考虑通过将所提出的输出投影到安全椭球上对其进行修正的情形。计算这一投影等价于求解一个二次约束二次规划（QCQP）问题。我们通过展开一种保持可行性的多项式惩罚迭代来构建神经网络安全层。这种展开结构使得损失梯度在训练过程中能够从可行输出穿过安全层传播到网络参数。我们展示了如何选择层参数以保证每次迭代均可行，并在任意给定深度下给出其与精确投影之间距离的可计算界限。我们通过训练基于激光雷达（LiDAR）的策略来控制无人机以展示该方法。一个具有特权信息的模型…
tldr: 该论文提出通过展开保持可行性的多项式惩罚迭代构建神经网络安全层，将网络输出投影到安全椭球上以强制满足约束，保证每次迭代均可行并提供与精确投影距离的可计算界限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a neural-network safety layer built by unrolling a feasibility-preserving polynomial penalty iteration that projects network outputs onto a safety ellipsoid, ensuring feasible iterates with a computable bound on the distance to the exact projection.
